newsitem.title: UK: BFI down five but brokers sense sentiment change.
newsitem.headline: BFI down five but brokers sense sentiment change.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was down five to 1,259 and the Baltic Handy Index down eight to 1,090 points.

Brokers reported increasing resistance from Panamax owners to the declining trend in rates and there was confidence in the owners camp that with more chartering orders now being quoted, steadier conditions will shortly apply, especially in the Atlantic.

Firmer rates were seen from the Plate to Far East grain trades with Oldendorff fixing Drin 73,000 dwt at $12,500 daily plus $260,000 bonus and Continental Spirit 65,000 dwt $12,000 daily plus $250,000 bonus to Great Chance, both for early May delivery but on subjects.
At 1300 GMT BIFFEX was five to eight points lower in the traded positions and turnover was only 11 lots.
